```{r}
# define chromosome order
chroms <- c(as.character(1:14), "Z")

# function to read one chromosome
read_chr <- function(chr) {
  fread(file.path(reports_path, "local_pca", "100", chr, "pcoa_coords.tsv")) %>%
    mutate(
      chr = gsub("^chr", "", chr),
      landmark = as.character(landmark)   # <-- fix here
    )
}

# read all and combine
pca_list <- map(chroms, read_chr)
pca <- bind_rows(pca_list)

pca <- pca %>%
  arrange(factor(chr, levels = chroms), window_id) %>%
  group_by(chr) %>%
  mutate(chr_max = max(window_id)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(offset = lag(cumsum(chr_max), default = 0)) %>%
  mutate(window_id = window_id + offset)

pca <- pca %>%
  mutate(landmark = paste0("chr", chr))

pca <- pca %>%
  mutate(landmark = factor(landmark, levels = paste0("chr", chroms)))

axisdf <- pca %>%
  group_by(landmark) %>%
  summarize(center = (max(window_id) + min(window_id)) / 2, .groups = "drop")

local_pca <- 
pca %>%
  # Remove windows whose first SNP falls in the first 200 kb of a chromosome.
  # These subtelomeric windows have inflated PC scores due to low recombination,
  # assembly gaps, and unreliable genotyping — they are not interpretable as
  # selection signals.
  filter(as.integer(str_extract(position, "\\d+")) >= 200000) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = window_id, y = PC1, col = as.factor(landmark))) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = axisdf$center,
    labels = gsub("chr|scaffold", "", axisdf$landmark),
    expand = c(0.01, 0.01)
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
 values = rep(c("#2C3E50", "#95A5A6"), length.out = length(chroms))
) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black"),
    text = element_text(family = "roboto_condensed", size = 16),
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5) 
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 4 * sd(pca$PC1, na.rm = TRUE), linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -4 * sd(pca$PC1, na.rm = TRUE), linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    x = "\nChromosome",
    y = "PC2\n",
    title = "Local PCA: PC1 values across genomic 100bp windows",
    subtitle = "Dashed lines indicate 4 standard deviations from the mean"
  )

ggsave(
  local_pca,
  filename = file.path(figures_path, "local_pca", "local_pca_plot_PC1.png"),
  width = 16,
  height = 4
)
```

```{r}
# ── 1. Read + prepare PCA data ───────────────────────────────────────────────
pca_raw <- bind_rows(map(chroms, read_chr)) %>%
  arrange(factor(chr, levels = chroms), window_id) %>%
  mutate(
    coords = map(position, extract_bounds),
    start  = map_int(coords, "start"),
    end    = map_int(coords, "end")
  ) %>%
  select(-coords) %>%
  # Remove subtelomeric windows (first 200 kb per chromosome): low
  # recombination and assembly gaps inflate PC scores there spuriously.
  filter(start >= 200000)

# ── 2. Global outlier detection (LEFT TAIL, matches your manual filter) ──────
flag_outliers_global <- function(df, pc_col, sd_thresh = 4) {
  
  mu  <- mean(df[[pc_col]], na.rm = TRUE)
  sig <- sd(df[[pc_col]],   na.rm = TRUE)
  
  df %>%
    mutate(
      value   = .data[[pc_col]],
      outlier = value < (mu - sd_thresh * sig),  # left tail only
      pc      = pc_col
    ) %>%
    filter(outlier) %>%
    select(chr, start, end, pc, value)
}

# Apply across PCs
outliers <- bind_rows(
  flag_outliers_global(pca_raw, "PC1"),
  flag_outliers_global(pca_raw, "PC2"),
  flag_outliers_global(pca_raw, "PC3")
)

# ── 3. Merge nearby outlier windows into regions ─────────────────────────────
merge_windows <- function(df, max_gap = 100000, min_windows = 5) {
  df %>%
    arrange(chr, pc, start) %>%
    group_by(chr, pc) %>%
    mutate(
      gap = start - lag(start),
      new_group = cumsum(is.na(gap) | gap > max_gap)
    ) %>%
    group_by(chr, pc, new_group) %>%
    summarise(
      region_start = min(start),
      region_end   = max(end),
      n_windows    = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    filter(n_windows >= min_windows)
}

regions <- merge_windows(outliers)

# ── 4. Output ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
print(regions, n = 50)

write.csv(
  regions,
  file.path(reports_path, "local_pca", "pc_outlier_regions.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
outliers_path <- file.path(reports_path, "local_pca", "outliers")

# ── Load sample metadata (adjust path / sex column name as needed) ────────────
sample_info <- fread(file.path(data_path, "dfs_processed", "wgs_europe_metadata.csv")) %>%
  select(sample_name, sex, region) %>%
  rename(IID = sample_name)

# ── Helper: read eigenvec + eigenval, join metadata, plot ─────────────────────
plot_region_pca <- function(region_dir, sample_info) {

  region_label <- basename(region_dir)

  eigenvec_file <- file.path(region_dir, paste0(region_label, "_pca.eigenvec"))
  eigenval_file <- file.path(region_dir, paste0(region_label, "_pca.eigenval"))

  if (!file.exists(eigenvec_file)) {
    message("Skipping (no eigenvec): ", region_label)
    return(NULL)
  }

  # ── Read files ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  ev <- fread(eigenvec_file, header = FALSE) %>%
    setNames(c("FID", "IID", paste0("PC", 1:(ncol(.) - 2))))

  eigenvals <- fread(eigenval_file, header = FALSE)$V1
  pct       <- round(eigenvals / sum(eigenvals) * 100, 1)

  plot_df <- ev %>% left_join(sample_info, by = "IID")
  plot_df$PC1 <- as.numeric(as.character(plot_df$PC1))
  plot_df$PC2 <- as.numeric(as.character(plot_df$PC2))

  # ── Parse label for subtitle ────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # label format: chrX_PCY_start_end
  parts <- str_match(region_label, "chr(.+)_(PC\\d)_(\\d+)_(\\d+)")
  chr   <- parts[2]; pc <- parts[3]
  start <- as.integer(parts[4]); end <- as.integer(parts[5])
  subtitle <- glue::glue("chr{chr}:{start}-{end}  |  flagged by {pc}")

  # ── Plot ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # ── Plot ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, colour = region)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.85) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "Spain"    = "#E41A1C",
      "UK"       = "#377EB8",
      "Norway"   = "#4DAF4A",
      "Shetland" = "#984EA3"
    ),
    name = "Region",
    na.value = "#95A5A6"
  ) +
scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(
    subtitle = subtitle,
    x = paste0("\nPC1 (", pct[1], "%)\n"),
    y = paste0("\nPC2 (", pct[2], "%)\n")
  ) +
  theme(
  panel.grid = element_blank(),
  panel.background = element_blank(),
  plot.background = element_blank(),
  text = element_text(family = "roboto_condensed", size = 14),
  plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, colour = "grey40"),
  legend.position = "right"
)

  out_file <- file.path(figures_path, "local_pca", paste0(region_label, "_pca.png"))
  ggsave(p, filename = out_file, width = 6, height = 5, dpi = 150)
  message("Saved: ", out_file)
  return(p)
}

# ── Run over all region directories ──────────────────────────────────────────
region_dirs <- list.dirs(outliers_path, recursive = FALSE, full.names = TRUE)

plots <- map(region_dirs, plot_region_pca, sample_info = sample_info)

# ── Optional: single combined panel ──────────────────────────────────────────
plots_clean <- compact(plots)

combined <- wrap_plots(plots_clean, ncol = 4) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Local PCA outlier regions — PLINK PCA",
    theme = theme(
      plot.title = element_text(family = "roboto_condensed", face = "bold",
                                size = 16, hjust = 0.5)
    )
  )

ggsave(
  combined,
  filename = file.path(figures_path, "local_pca", "all_regions_combined.png"),
  width = 24, height = ceiling(length(plots_clean) / 4) * 5,
  dpi = 150
)
```

```{r}
chr   <- "3"
pc    <- "PC3"
start <- 35721485
end   <- 35831305

region_label <- paste0("chr", chr, "_", pc, "_", start, "_", end)
region_dir   <- file.path(outliers_path, region_label)

# ── Check inputs exist ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
eigenvec_file <- file.path(region_dir, paste0(region_label, "_pca.eigenvec"))
eigenval_file <- file.path(region_dir, paste0(region_label, "_pca.eigenval"))

if (!file.exists(eigenvec_file)) {
  stop("Missing eigenvec file: ", eigenvec_file)
}
if (!file.exists(eigenval_file)) {
  stop("Missing eigenval file: ", eigenval_file)
}

# ── Read PCA outputs ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ev <- fread(eigenvec_file, header = FALSE)
setNames(ev, c("FID", "IID", paste0("PC", 1:(ncol(ev) - 2)))) -> ev

eigenvals <- fread(eigenval_file, header = FALSE)$V1
pct       <- round(eigenvals / sum(eigenvals) * 100, 1)

# ── Read heterozygosity output ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
het_file <- file.path(region_dir, paste0(region_label, "_het.het"))

het_info <- fread(het_file, header = TRUE) %>%
  select(INDV, F) %>%
  rename(IID = INDV, F_het = F)

# ── Merge metadata ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
plot_df <- ev %>%
  left_join(sample_info, by = "IID") %>%
  left_join(het_info, by = "IID")

# ── Subtitle ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
subtitle <- glue("chr{chr}:{start}-{end}  |  flagged by {pc}")

# ── Plot ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
p <- plot_df %>%
mutate(
    PC1 = as.numeric(PC1),
    PC2 = as.numeric(PC2)
  ) %>%
filter(!is.na(region)) %>%  
ggplot(aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, colour = region)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.85) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "Spain"    = "#E41A1C",
      "UK"       = "#377EB8",
      "Norway"   = "#4DAF4A",
      "Shetland" = "#984EA3"
    ),
    name = "Region",
    na.value = "#95A5A6"
  ) +
scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(
    subtitle = subtitle,
    x = paste0("PC1 (", pct[1], "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", pct[2], "%)")
  ) +
  theme(
  panel.grid = element_blank(),
  panel.background = element_blank(),
  plot.background = element_blank(),
  text = element_text(family = "roboto_condensed", size = 14),
  plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, colour = "grey40"),
  legend.position = "right"
)

t <- plot_df %>%
mutate(
    PC1 = as.numeric(PC1),
    PC2 = as.numeric(PC2)
  ) %>%
filter(!is.na(region)) %>%  
ggplot(aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, colour = F_het)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.85) +
scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_colour_viridis_c(option = "C") +
  labs(
    subtitle = subtitle,
    x = paste0("PC1 (", pct[1], "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", pct[2], "%)")
  ) +
  theme(
  panel.grid = element_blank(),
  panel.background = element_blank(),
  plot.background = element_blank(),
  text = element_text(family = "roboto_condensed", size = 14),
  plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, colour = "grey40"),
  legend.position = "right"
)

# ── Save output ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
out_file <- file.path(figures_path, "local_pca", paste0(region_label, "_pca.png"))
dir.create(dirname(out_file), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

g <- p+t

ggsave(g, filename = out_file, width = 12, height = 5, dpi = 150)

message("Saved: ", out_file)

# ── Return plot to viewer ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
print(p)

cluster1 <- plot_df %>%
  filter(PC1<0.05) %>%
  pull(IID)

cluster2 <- plot_df %>%
  filter(PC1>0.05 & PC1<0.1) %>%
  pull(IID)

cluster3 <- plot_df %>%
  filter(PC1>=0.1) %>%
  pull(IID)

write.table(
  cluster1,
  file.path(reports_path, "local_pca", "outliers", "chr3_cluster1_samples.csv"),
  quote = FALSE,
  row.names = FALSE,
  col.names = FALSE
)

write.table(

write.table(

  file.path(reports_path, "local_pca", "outliers", "chr3_cluster3_samples.csv"),

  row.names = FALSE,
  col.names = FALSE
)
```
